node.question: Does the image show the background changed into a recognizable basketball court?
node.criteria: Use all support observations. Absent only when evidence establishes that no requested background progress occurred. Unknown when necessary evidence is unavailable, unresolved, or insufficient; do not infer visual facts beyond the supports.
